In this video, we break down the Python Developer Salary in 2026 and compare earnings in India vs USA across different experience levels.

If you are planning to become a Python developer or already working in Python, this detailed salary breakdown will help you understand your earning potential. 

From fresher salaries (0–2 years) to mid-level, senior, and lead roles, we explain how Python developer salaries are growing rapidly in 2026. 

In India, entry-level salaries start from ₹3–5 LPA and can go beyond ₹25 LPA for experienced professionals, while in the USA, salaries range from $70,000 to over $200,000 per year depending on skills and experience. 

Python is one of the highest-paying programming skills today, and demand is increasing in fields like data science, AI, machine learning, and backend development. 

Watch till the end to understand why Python development is becoming a career goldmine in 2026.
